wrapper: A PHP bootstrap loads a platform/PHP-version ionCube module and hands control to _il_exec(); an encoded payload follows the closing PHP tag.
related_files: index.php, control.php, java.php, load.php and seven CP-ENC helpers have the same protected form.
source_collection_evidence: The directory identifies Crimepack 3.1.3, pairs 003.ini with 003.php and includes Java delivery/archive assets. README installation requirements include PHP5 and ionCube.
limits: The ionCube payload was not decrypted or executed.
No PHP consumer/control-flow edge or Java vulnerability implementation was recovered from the protected bytes.
The nearby JARs were inventoried; they are not attributed to the specific javagetval exploit without a recovered loader path.
